title: docs export request (confirm)
description: POST /sessions/{id}/docs-export. Idempotency-Key REQUIRED. The explicit confirm. provider is fixed to demo_docs: nothing real can be expressed. contentDigest must equal the digest of the content the server would write now (else 412 precondition_failed, nothing written). expectedExistingDocId and expectedExistingVersion are the id and version of the existing document the student saw in the preview, both null if the preview showed none (any mismatch: 412). mode must be one the preview listed. The client sends no text, title or document.

expectedExistingDocId.description: Id of the existing document the student saw in the preview, or null if none (DXD-05). Binds the confirm to the document, not only to its version. Mismatch with the current document: 412.

allOf.description: create goes with no existing document; update and create_another need one.
